## Ratchet extended (crates/nmp-testing/tests/read_door_public_surface_retired.rs)
- Added all 6 deleted files to `absent_files`.
- Removed the now-dangling check tuple that grepped the deleted `nmp-native-runtime/src/op_pointer_source/mod.rs` for `"pub fn open_pointer_source("` (would have panicked on missing file otherwise).
- Added two new check tuples banning `"open_pointer_source"`/`"register_pointer_source"` from reappearing in `crates/nmp-content/src/lib.rs` and `crates/nmp-content/src/pointer_source/mod.rs`.
